name: Beat The Robloxian!
desc:
❗ BETA BUILD - bugs and instability are to be expected, many things are subject to change ❗

BTR is a chaotic Incremental PVE experience about fighting & beating up robloxians using everything you have at your own disposal in unpredictable worlds. 

💥 Now featuring Wave Defense Mode - accessed in base game on your right

🫂 Playing with others makes it so much better, invite some friends!

✨ Premium players have a 10% cash bonus.

⚠️ In case of performance problems, try changing the following settings:
Enable "No Visual Tracers", "Low Graphics"
Disable "Gore", "Blood"
